scope: Read every original source/access/book envelope, original individual question and all current director questions. No earlier full procedures/cases exist; no new authoring decisions or acceptance.

perIdentityFindings.alignment-scrying: Strong location energy is not established by the effective alignment of any nearby creature. Need actual authenticated location/channel/scene facts and explicit60ft versus remote-range interpretation. Instantaneous bounded sample and ongoing sensor are materially different choices; neither grants wall penetration or secret inventories.
perIdentityFindings.commune: Needs a qualified actual respondent/contact and three bounded questions. Deity name/worship mask is not proof of an independently existing being, and powerful entity does not mean arbitrary class level. Truth, cooperation, knowledge and contact success are distinct. No automatic yes/no restriction or omniscience. Actual dangerous knowledge/Hunt rules require concrete trigger and correctly timed warning, not generic punishment for casting.
perIdentityFindings.planar-binding-minor: Distinct Divination6 identity, CR<=8, extraplanar and existing current creature. Do not merge ordinary rank5PlanarBinding or derive CR from level/HP. Compelled service needs finite command/control and resistance rules; original summon lifetime/resources/body remain and ending control is not automatic relocation.
perIdentityFindings.planar-summons-lesser: Actual Divination5, one Celestial/Elemental/Outsider CR<=5. No Conjuration replacement, outsider=Fiend invention or guessed CR for an unrated accepted pet. Complete authorized native profiles needed; manifestation versus called existing being is a substantive lifecycle choice.
perIdentityFindings.planar-summons-greater: Actual Divination7, two separately qualified allied extraplanar CR<=8 bodies, not one CR16 budget or GreaterPlanarAlly oneCR6/hour. Both arrivals and partial failure need exact physical state and shared owner command/offense; no independent free attack per body.
perIdentityFindings.soul-cage: Two source-school profiles remain: Enchantment Dying creature, Necromancy Dying humanoid, both actual Action. Stable/Dead do not satisfy Dying. Preserve whole-event would-die replacements and real Ready timing; do not adopt feat Reaction. Define one identity/custody and finite fully enumerated uses; release custody is not resurrection or Hunt erasure. Current return blockers and exceptional intervention scope need actual source evidence.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Source: spy on a LOCATION where STRONG ALIGNMENT ENERGY exists; Divination5 Action60ft Instantaneous VSF10RP.
preservedQuestions.options: A: select one evidenced location with a separately authored strong-energy qualification. B: infer a location from any aligned person or presumed deity/plane name.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Define the actual required location knowledge, maximum destination distance and same/cross-place permissions. Core60ft is preserved evidence and cannot become unlimited by silence. Distinguish casting anchor/range from remote location range only by a declared NEW rule. Actual effective alignment of a creature is not by itself strong location energy. Unknown qualification remains unknown; no search reveals a secret location merely by declaring its desired alignment.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Spy implies information but no sensor, channels, field of view or duration is printed.
preservedQuestions.options: A: one instantaneous bounded sensory sample. B: an ongoing mobile sensor requiring a new finite duration and concentration exception.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer A if it preserves useful spying; ask GPT to settle the genuine choice. Specify source point, actual visible/audible channels, three-dimensional sample area, occlusion, illumination, observer viewpoint, perceptible sensor status and detection/countering. Do not grant through-wall vision, translated speech, hidden inventories, exact stats, alignment detection of every occupant or future knowledge. Supply all facts from an authored scene snapshot; a missing scene is a content hold.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Information wards, unknown location qualification and opponent consent cannot be assumed from the spell name.
preservedQuestions.options: A: reuse exact accepted information permissions and actual target/ward predicates. B: bypass every ward as alignment magic or grant a new save without source decision.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify whether no qualifying site means preflight rejection or paid hidden failure without diagnostic leak; identify any resistance as NEW. Distinguish the location target from creatures incidentally observed. Seal Vision, Nondetection and other actual reviewed counterparts apply only at their own scope; access does not prove cosmic identity. Ordinary Null and suppression timing must be explicit for the sample.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Ask THREE questions to a DEITY OR POWERFUL ENTITY; Divination5 Action60ft Instantaneous VSF10RP.
preservedQuestions.options: A: bounded contact with a real authored eligible respondent. B: an anonymous omniscient answer service or a newly invented patron being.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Define eligibility and how the caster addresses a respondent using an earned channel/known name without requiring hidden true identity. Powerful entity needs a concrete authored qualification, not class level alone. Preserve the deity alternative while respecting that a worship mask/class patron title does not prove an independent being. Unknown respondent authority/contact is a content hold. Choose whether60ft concerns an actual local respondent or a new contact locus; remote reach is an explicit decision, not assumed planar access.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Three questions have no printed yes/no restriction, word limit, answer guarantee or conversation duration.
preservedQuestions.options: A: a finite single resolution with exactly three bounded questions and explicit finite answer forms. B: indefinite conversation or import an external yes/no spell wholesale.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose new limits that preserve three meaningful questions. Specify multipart questions, follow-up wording, simultaneous versus ordered answers, language comprehension, refusal/unknown/ambiguous answers and record visibility. Truthful bounded knowledge can be recommended, but truth, cooperation and omniscience are separate rules needing concurrence. A failed contact must not masquerade as a negative answer. No extra Fate presentation or reroll creates knowledge.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Current owner/reviewed cosmology keeps source facts, mortal theology, respondent knowledge and public revelation separate.
preservedQuestions.options: A: answers constrained by actual respondent knowledge and authored scene disclosure. B: automatically reveal Heartcell, Choir/patron equivalences, the Equation, soul jurisdiction or present epoch.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with actual authored information, not blanket refusal of useful questions. Ordinary answers may disclose real earned facts. A specific dangerous research/operational revelation uses the reviewed KT/PT/Hunt predicates at actual timing; mere casting or three questions never automatically triggers Hunt. Any voluntary Hunt-capable commitment must receive its real warning before cost; do not retroactively punish an innocuous question. Known access/ward checks and paid hidden failure need explicit ordering.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Divination6 source compels ONE EXTRAPLANAR creature CR8 or lower to serve; Action60ft Instantaneous VSF13RP.
preservedQuestions.options: A: preserve this distinct identity and target predicate. B: alias it to accepted rank5 Planar Binding or infer extraplanar status from creature type.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. A current full profile and authoritative CR must support the ceiling; class level, summon rank and HP cannot manufacture CR. Source-explicit extraplanar status can be known while home/native plane remains unknown; discuss exactly what the target needs. Provide sight/line-of-effect, willingness versus hostility, immunities and a NEW resistance save or opposed method. Preserve ordinary Planar Binding as a full comparison only.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Compelled service has no printed duration, order language, concentration or repeat save.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicit finite service/control with bounded orders and resistance opportunities. B: permanent unrestricted ownership or an instantaneous single command.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose and justify a useful NEW completion, preserving original Instantaneous as source conflict. Spell-specific control immunity, communication, one active controller, conflict precedence, prohibited/suicidal orders and damage-trigger/turn-end escape must be explicit. Use actual control and pending-order lifecycle only by an express new extension. Breaking/losing concentration or suppression cannot leave indefinite compulsory service. Ending compulsion need not teleport a pre-existing real creature or erase its independent motives.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: An existing bound creature is not automatically a freshly created summon and cannot gain free actions or another body.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete current-actor state and explicit command/action economy. B: reset HP/resources/life, take ownership of carried gear or add a free companion phase.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Decide existing initiative versus attached phase, limits shared with other owner assets, order delivery/range, default action and command expiry. Track prior summon owner and deadline separately; binding must not refresh an existing creature duration, transfer original damage provenance by implication or duplicate a body. Costs, failure, caster death, lost communication and real release must preserve custody and ordinary agency.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Divination5 summons ONE CELESTIAL, ELEMENTAL OR OUTSIDER CR5 or lower; Action60ft Conc60 VSF10RP.
preservedQuestions.options: A: a selectable roster of complete current native profiles with independently supported type/CR. B: import an outside stat block or assign CR to an unrated pet.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A and keep the Divination school/class acquisition. Define outsider using existing native authority or hold that option while preserving its source promise; do not quietly replace it with Fiend. An unrated accepted summon is not an eligible CR5 target simply because its numbers seem similar. Missing profiles remain explicit content holds; a new native profile and rating need separate review. Do not promote old incomplete workbook rows to usable creatures.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Divination7 summons TWO EXTRAPLANAR ALLIES CR8 or lower EACH; Action120ft Conc60 VSF17RP.
preservedQuestions.options: A: two independently qualified complete profiles with distinct instance identities. B: one CR16 budget, one ally, or copy accepted Greater Planar Ally CR6/hour.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Preserve two allies and each ceiling; determine whether exactly two or up-to-two is a new permission. Both must qualify as actual allies and extraplanar independently; shared type/name does not merge their identity. No patron/plane inference from names. Define duplicate roster choice versus duplicate existing individual, partial eligibility/arrival and preflight costs without leaking unknown profile facts.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Summon does not resolve whether these are temporary manifestations or transport of independently existing beings.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicitly bounded temporary manifestations with source-qualified profiles. B: real called individuals with complete origin, consent and terminal-return evidence.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Discuss both and choose source-faithfully; neither can be inferred from the school/name. If A, define no duplicate soul/corpse/harvest and distinguish a spell instance from a pre-existing person. If B, require real origin state, absence elsewhere, transport prevention and complete return; do not invent a native plane. Define source-owner/type/healing/Wound/0HP and dispel/suppression lifecycle. No universal Banishment terminal exception is inherited automatically.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Both spells require actual body placement, companion commands and finite concentration deadlines.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete supported bodies and exact owner-wide command/offense timing. B: abstract tokens, extra free attacks for each summoned ally or deadline reset through suppression.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Profiles include volume, height, mass, six abilities, defenses, senses, handling, movement, attacks and any equipment/uses. Define range at creation versus command/maintenance, birth/attached phase and legality of ordering either/both bodies under the shared offense ceiling. Clarify innate spells/resources without free refill, actual creationHP feature scope, real cargo/loot, final placement and retained external items. Greater has two distinct arrivals and endings; partial failure must be explicit.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Enchantment6 traps a DYING CREATURE soul and uses it for various effects; Necromancy6 traps a DYING HUMANOID soul. Both Action60ft Instantaneous VSF13RP.
preservedQuestions.options: A: retain school-qualified target scope and explicitly decide which benefits are shared. B: union both source placements and let every class choose the broadest version.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Wizard/Bard/Mirrorsage/Crimson Agent actual access is Enchantment; Cleric/Druid/Shaman is Necromancy. A single catalog identity does not erase these differences. The unrelated Soul Cage feat is comparison only, not a spell procedure or automatic granted benefit. Define proof of an eligible soul without declaring all creatures/types possess or lack souls.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Source says DYING and casting time Action, not Reaction when a creature dies; current death model distinguishes Dying, Stable, Dead and replacement windows.
preservedQuestions.options: A: ordinary Action captures/marks an eligible presently Dying target under an explicit new procedure. B: paid Ready after a real trigger or a new death-window reaction rule.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve the Action. Discuss whether immediate capture can coexist with a living Dying body, or whether a bounded prospective mark captures only at committed death; either is NEW. Do not silently turn dying into dead, make the spell kill the target, block stabilization, bypass a would-die replacement or reach backward after death. Ready setup and its actual reaction release need complete timing, paid resources and target legality. Whole-event Instant Death/Wound and Death Ward versus Ritual of Undeath remain distinct.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No cage material, custody, duration, capacity, resistance or release terms are printed.
preservedQuestions.options: A: one finite nonduplicating custody record with a complete physical or magical container model. B: indefinite portable souls, cloned identities or unbounded stacks.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose actual range/sight/LoE, resistance/consent, concentration or nonconcentration deadline, one-soul capacity, holder/owner and transferable custody. If physical, specify complete cage dimensions/mass/AC/HP, mundane versus magical material and actual acquisition/component consumption. If intangible, do not imply free physical cargo. Define suppression/dispel/destruction/caster death/expiry and priority of simultaneous competing cages. All release paths preserve the same identity and history rather than granting resurrection.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Enchantment promises various uses but neither source lists a menu, amounts or use counts.
preservedQuestions.options: A: a small fully enumerated new menu with finite charges and action costs. B: import another game menu, arbitrary wishes or deny all use while calling the spell complete.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require GPT to propose the smallest source-faithful complete menu and flag every new effect for exact follow-up. For any knowledge mode, actual memory/language/revelation limits apply. For healing/resource modes, define legitimate recipients, real HP/RP caps, once-only consumption and ordinary anti-refund rules. No automatic new soul destruction, torture benefit, inherited skill/class feature, unlimited energy or learned Equation is granted. Decide if Necromancy gains this menu only through explicit sourced/new extension, otherwise preserve distinct modes.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Current reviewed soul rules preserve one continuing identity, committed-death history, Hunted Death and uniquely consumed rare intervention.
preservedQuestions.options: A: spell custody and return eligibility remain separate records. B: cage bypasses Hunt, erases death, creates a spare soul or becomes an ordinary Divine/Abyssal intervention.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Determine whether actual capture creates a narrowly defined return blocker and what release removes; never infer pending Resurrection/Clone efficacy. An actual independently authored intervention must explicitly override the relevant blocker and settle body, HP, Wounds, inventory, location and obligations. Returning an alive Dying target, reviving a dead identity and releasing custody are different operations. Actual resurrection/cage conflicts need a named rule, not lore inference.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The prior source questions postponed cosmology-linked work until the preservation push; that push is now independently verified.
preservedQuestions.options: A: discuss finite spell mechanics with complete original manuscripts, saved website and owner qualifications. B: treat the push as adoption of the mortal Wheel, website topology, planar clock conversion or a soul/deity identity.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Keep original source evidence, mortal beliefs, current scoped mechanics and unresolved owner choices separate. Neither helper plane keys nor a functioning class/spell proves hidden ontology. No missing World I–VI, Equation content, Serit bridge, Maladomini ruler, Heartcell builder or campaign epoch may be invented. Genuine setting-content dependencies are explicit holds, not fabricated defaults or a reason to erase the printed spell.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No earlier complete procedures or operational scenarios exist for these six identities; original question records must remain unchanged.
preservedQuestions.options: A: resolve each real question, then author complete legal current cases and seek exact acceptance. B: promote a source packet, conditional snippet, passing file check or consent to discuss into completed review.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Each later case needs real accessible caster/class level, RP and all used counters, school-specific acquisition, V/S/F, finite time and actual body/source state. Preserve all original source/questions; at least two full cases per identity plus every distinct school/form/profile/return branch. Missing eligible creature/scene/respondent/soul evidence remains a whole-case hold. No blanket C risk, deletion, runtime/human/balance/cosmology or whole-domain closure.

futureCaseRequirements: After genuine choices, at least two full current legal cases per identity plus all distinct school/profile/return branches; preserve original questions and no invented old cases.
Actual class/level/repertoire, RP and every used engine counter, school-specific acquisition, V/S/F, timing, physical geometry/body/cargo/Load and full source provenance.
Alignment Scrying real location/energy and sensory evidence; Commune real qualified respondent/channel and exactly three source-bounded answers with honest hidden-failure behavior.
Minor Binding exact CR8 and extraplanar evidence, resistance, service, ownership, expiry and independent body lifecycle; no automatic arrival or refill.
Lesser summons actual allowed type/CR5; Greater two distinct extraplanar CR8 allies, all complete profiles, separate placement/return and shared owner command/offense constraints.

Soul Cage distinct school scope, true Dying versus Stable/Dead, Action/Ready timing, whole-event prevention, one identity/custody, every enumerated use, release/return/Hunt and body/inventory outcome.
Unavailable creature, soul, respondent, scene or origin authority remains an explicitly held whole case; conditional arithmetic is not a completed operational case.
No runtime, human gameplay, balance, soul/deity/plane/campaign identity, publication/release or75-domain completion from source preparation.
